fields.Name: CRD-09 - Invitations
fields.Description: Verify applicant invitation and link re-issuance: InviteApplicant creates subject, Common party record, external user with Credentialing Applicant role and Credentialing app row, subject contact, Draft application, and empty standard responses in one transaction; refuses Draft versions, cross-organization targets, duplicate open applications, internal accounts, and non-staff callers; survives issuer outages with InvitationNote and succeeds on ReissueInvitation; updates UserCache immediately for existing external users; and leaves staff unable to create MJ: Magic Link Invites directly.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All cred-invite checks pass with a fixture InvitationIssuer; live issuance, redemption, invite role/application check, and parallel shared-email races pass in cred-invite-wire against MJAPI.
